features.notes: Previous real IME evidence covers one Windows/IME/runtime combination. Hidden explicit-text paste now preserves completed Hangul, decomposed jamo and emoji exactly at pre-ConPTY and ReadConsoleW boundaries. This is not new OS clipboard or real IME acceptance.
One Windows/IME/runtime combination verified; full review acceptance remains open.

Interactive move trial was contaminated by concurrent user desktop input. Redundant native focus is avoided in code, but real IME validation of that change remains pending. User requested background-only work.

Windows-only built-in Windows PowerShell/CMD/PowerShell 7 discovery, default and per-tab/workspace executable/argv, split inheritance and persisted per-surface shells implemented. Hidden hosts verify real PowerShell/CMD, exact Unicode cwd/argv, relative CLI cwd, mixed-shell restart, old state and explicit failed-start recovery. PATH/PATHEXT executable ordering has native file tests. Actual PS7 (unavailable locally), other interactive shells, command-language parsing, aliases, UNC/long paths and physical menus/IME remain pending.

Configurable terminal scrollback 0–100000 lines applies to live xterm views and persists across Windows hosts. Hidden native test reduces it to 100, emits 600 lines, verifies old history eviction and retained new output. Native scrollbar/selection/IME, memory/load and complete scrollback parity remain pending.

Exact 128 KiB UTF-8 selection snapshots survive TUI redraw/erase, hidden or moved tabs and process exit; explicit clear/search/input/buffer transitions discard them. CLI selection read/all/range/clear waits for parsing without clipboard access or target activation. Clipboard shortcuts and a terminal context menu are implemented with focus/visibility/composition cancellation and no retry. Ten hidden WebView2/ConPTY selection checks and mocked frontend clipboard/menu tests pass. Real OS clipboard, physical drag/double-click/column selection, shortcuts/menu, IME/DPI/accessibility, large-selection memory and all race acceptance remain pending.

CLI paste waits for prior PTY output parsing and uses xterm current bracketed-paste mode. Hidden native tests verify mode on/off, multiline Unicode, empty no-op, 128 KiB boundary and inactive-surface routing at both input boundaries. Literal controls remain literal; this is not sanitization. Desktop clipboard, all timeout/close/queue races, shell/TUI interoperability and broad IME acceptance remain pending.

Native hidden WebView2/ConPTY verifies retained Korean next/previous/wrap, case/regex, invalid-expression recovery, NFD/emoji selected text, soft-wrap crossing, hidden/moved/exited surfaces and normal/alternate separation. Real same-cursor overwrite reproduced stale addon cache; parser-complete invalidation fixes that case. Synthetic composition guards are not real IME evidence. Search-field IME, buttons/focus/DPI, complex expression latency and PCRE2 differences remain open.

Native hidden Windows host searches parsed retained output across inactive tabs/workspaces with literal/case matching, 500-line pages, native result list and two-stage activation. Korean/NFD/emoji, 260+ physical-row soft wraps, append/move preservation, rewrite/reflow/eviction refusal, alternate isolation and cancellation verified. Native mouse/keyboard/IME, visual layout/DPI, sustained-output/load and SSH integration remain pending. Changed-during-scan terminals are reported unavailable; each page rescans current output.

read-screen and capture-pane share parser-barrier viewport reads with stable surface targeting, bounded exact text and buffer/range metadata. Hidden native WebView2/ConPTY checks cover Unicode, soft wraps, overwrite/CR/erase, retained selection/scroll position, hidden and moved tabs, alternate isolation and process exit. 128 KiB limits, error recovery and split-byte barriers are covered by frontend/Rust tests. Native oversized-grid/timeout/close races, sustained load, broader TUI/Unicode/reflow and full capture compatibility remain pending; tmux capture flags are not implemented.

--recent reads at most 80 latest normal-buffer physical rows independently of viewport/cursor, or the full alternate screen including footer rows. On-demand extraction avoids copying full history on every output. Ten hidden native screen checks include these ranges and inactive parsing. Agent status polling/classification is not wired yet; sustained-load budgets, rate limiting and broader TUI/Unicode acceptance remain pending.

Cell-based canvas minimap reads bounded normal-buffer rows via public xterm APIs, including wide Hangul, truecolor, ANSI palette, inverse/dim/invisible and backgrounds. Preview wheel and terminal seek are separate; keyboard navigation, parser-barrier CLI and hidden-tab raster suspension are implemented. Nine hidden native checks verify actual canvas checksums, colors/cells, scroll changes, selection preservation, history clearing and moved/exited surfaces. Physical pointer/keyboard/IME/accessibility, sustained multi-pane load and OSC palette mutation remain pending.

Shared persisted minimap settings default to enabled/40 CSS pixels/50 percent; width 12..96 and opacity 0..100 apply live. Alternate mode hides painting but retains gutter and ConPTY columns, verified in a hidden native host. Disabled minimaps release raster/gutter and reset preview. Rendering caps preview to 2048 rows and raster scale to 2x; high-DPI/multimonitor/visual/menu and active-composition acceptance remain pending.

Hidden Windows restart preserves Korean and green SGR normal-buffer history across fresh ConPTY startup, including inactive tabs; bounded to complete rows within 128 KiB. Alternate screen, broader style/Unicode/wrap fidelity and restoration IME remain pending.

PowerShell prompt integration and CMD child-only PROMPT reports preserve local Unicode cwd, tab/split inheritance and persisted cwd. Explicit CLI/launcher relative cwd is resolved at invocation; raw IPC relative cwd uses its source terminal. Hidden native probes verify Korean/NFD/emoji/ampersand paths. CMD uses /D; raw custom executable selections do not add prompt integration. Other shells, AutoRun/prompt frameworks, UNC/device/remote paths, long paths and interactive IME remain open.

The existing pure Rust OSC extractor/parser/store are reused read-only. Hidden native ConPTY delivers ST-terminated OSC 9/99/777 with exact Korean, NFD jamo and emoji; numeric OSC 9 cwd/progress metadata is excluded. Output byte/time observations are exposed without agent classification. BEL transport, other ConPTY/OS/shell combinations, Kitty multipart features, notify-stream/pty-tee and hook integration remain pending.

Native settings menu/editor and CLI implement shared font/fallback list, 6–72px size with larger/smaller/reset, dark/light terminal theme and cursor blink/style. Hidden native hosts verify exact Unicode values, actual xterm options/colors and ConPTY grid with stable shell PIDs. Real menu/IME/DPI, installed font fallback/width, custom themes, whole-app colors and configurable zoom shortcuts remain pending.

Named keys use parser-barrier cursor-mode snapshots and stable surface targeting. 128 pinned-xterm reference vectors are checked in normal/application modes against pre-ConPTY and ReadConsoleW bytes. Guards cover composition/settling/restore and bounded pending input; no synthetic desktop input is used. Physical repeat, actual focus reporting/IME transitions, advanced protocols, all timeout/close races and broader shell/TUI acceptance remain pending.

Hidden hosts and native tests verify natural exit/final output, process-tree ownership, 100 tab cycles, invalid executable and missing restored executable, saveable failed terminals and explicit same-surface CMD retry. Native startup suppresses system error dialogs and restores thread error mode; failed unwinding closes undrained output before ConPTY. Physical recovery button, thread-start fault injection, hung child startup, WebView/GPU failure and broader lifecycle acceptance remain pending.

Native menus, UTF-16 name/color editor and CLI workspace operations implemented. Hidden native hosts verify Unicode/ampersand captions, title locks, 41 reorders with stable identities/processes, hidden caller context, targeted multi-terminal/descendant close and metadata/history restart. Final workspace remains protected; empty-window UI, drag reorder, sidebar overflow, automatic name reset, real menu/dialog/IME/DPI/accessibility remain pending.

Nested divider geometry and native drag handlers implemented. Hidden Windows verification checks CLI ratios, native WebView bounds, real ConPTY sizes, invalid request invariance, inactive workspace isolation and restart persistence. Actual divider drag, very small windows, DPI and composition during resize remain pending under background-only constraint.

Hidden native hosts verify tab moves/reorder with stable process, surface, output, cwd and calling-surface routing; user-locked Unicode tab names survive shell title output and restart without activation. Native rename dialog constructs hidden and preserves UTF-16 values, but actual menu/dialog IME and keyboard remain pending. Drag/drop, automatic title reset, cross-window and broader feature coverage remain.

Directional focus and temporary maximize/restore implemented with CLI, native button and guarded fixed shortcuts. Hidden Windows verification checks hidden Korean output, 40 zoom transitions with size convergence, stable processes, structural transitions and restart restoring normal layout. Physical keyboard/button, real IME, visual focus and accessibility remain pending.

Hidden Windows host verifies same-window moves/reorder with stable process, surface, viewport output, cwd and calling-surface CLI routing. Native menu and IME move rerun pending; rename, drag/drop, cross-window and broader feature coverage remain.

Native workspace/tab context menus and modeless UTF-16 metadata editor implemented. A hidden native Rust test constructs the editor and preserves Unicode values/error text without showing or focusing its HWND. Physical menus, dialogs, IME, DPI/accessibility, popovers and drag previews remain pending.

Existing xterm views apply shared terminal settings without shell recreation or requested focus; composition/history restore defers to the latest value. Hidden native tests verify multiple active/inactive tabs, another window, external edits and restart. Mock composition deferral is not real IME evidence. Native menus, real composition/focus/DPI, per-tab options and full settings parity remain pending.

Hidden Windows hosts preserve workspace/pane/surface identity, layout, focus, titles, local cwd, styled normal history and each terminal executable/argv in fresh processes. Default settings reload independently. Old state retains Windows PowerShell despite a changed default; missing executables leave a recoverable terminal. Window geometry, live-process recovery, agent resumption, wider style/Unicode fidelity and interactive IME remain pending.

Independent new windows launched from native terminals survive source-tab close, clean source-window quit, forced source-host exit and a further CMD launch. Caller cwd/PATH/Unicode environment and new CLI routing IDs are retained correctly through a bounded broker request. Ordinary terminal descendants retain strict job ownership. Shared settings/state leases have prior isolated evidence, but full multiwindow state, concurrency, existing-tab detachment and external-job policy coverage remain pending.

Native Notifications button/list, unread workspace/tab captions, CLI list/read/delete/clear/jump and stable source routing are implemented. Hidden controls and source lifecycle are verified. Output counters are observations only; activity/usage panels, panel switching and real input/accessibility remain pending.

Native WebView2 browser tabs reuse the shared right-sibling placement model and support explicit down splits. Hidden loopback verification covers source terminal identity, mixed pane moves and browser-only restore. Physical UI/IME, broader placement/lifecycle and cross-window acceptance remain pending.

Native address/Go, history, reload/stop, 0.5–3.0 zoom and loading/error status implemented. Native navigation IDs guard old completions. Hidden fixture verifies Unicode DOM/address text, back/forward, reload, redirect, stop recovery and network errors. Actual address IME/keyboard/button interaction, visual rendering/DPI/accessibility and HTTP/TLS breadth remain pending.

Top-document non-mutating DOM snapshots use shared headless Rust types and per-surface refs with window-wide unique tokens. Hidden WebView2 evidence covers Unicode grapheme excerpts, unique selectors, stale ref rejection after DOM/navigation/tab changes, moves and size bounds. Frame/shadow traversal, full accessibility semantics and complete pending-request races remain pending.

DOM click/dblclick/hover/scroll and focus/blur commands implemented with current-ref validation, per-surface admission and no automatic replay. Hidden live tests cover synthetic pointer events, scroll, stale DOM/tab/navigation refs and pending status. Focus/blur are intentionally refused in background test hosts; real focus, CSS hover, physical hit testing/selection, IME and exhaustive races remain pending.

Ref-based fill/select/check/uncheck implemented using native DOM setters and synthetic events. Hidden tests cover ordinal Unicode, newline/value rules, beforeinput cancellation/replacement/disable, readonly/file rejection, option precedence/multiple select and checkbox/radio idempotence. Active-element type/press, contenteditable/custom widgets, broad framework behavior and physical IME remain pending.

Synchronous eval, URL/title/status and read-only text/value/attr/count/is-visible/is-enabled/is-checked queries implemented. Hidden fixture verifies ordinal Unicode preservation, plain/JSON results, property/CSSOM reads, stale refs and output bounds. Asynchronous eval, broader accessibility state semantics, all pending-request races and complete automation parity remain pending.

Selector/text/URL/ready-state/synchronous JS waits implemented with surface pinning, one in-flight callback, native navigation epochs, deadline checks and bounded transport extension. Hidden fixture covers exact Unicode, delayed/streaming pages, timeout, runtime errors without replay, late callbacks, redirects, tab hiding/close, concurrent capacity and waits beyond default IPC deadlines. Prompt client-disconnect cancellation, transient states between polls, broader frame/shadow semantics and exhaustive races remain pending.

Native WebView2 viewport PNG capture implemented with CLI-relative Unicode paths, surface/navigation/viewport guards, size bounds, two pending slots and off-thread atomic save. Hidden fixture decodes actual pixels and covers scroll/zoom, active tabs, locked overwrite, invalid paths, loading rejection, concurrent capacity and viewport-change recovery. Physical DPI/minimized/multi-monitor behavior, remote filesystems, callback-loss/close/disconnect/timeout races and real IME remain pending.

Browser URL and surface identity persist separately from terminal histories/shells. A separate persistent WebView2 browser profile retains localStorage across a hidden browser-only restart. Private/nonpersistent mode, profile selection/management, bookmarks, cookies/login/session breadth and full acceptance remain pending.

Hidden native WebView2 downloads preserve UTF-8 filename* codepoints and payload bytes; staging/no-replace publication handles collisions, cancellation and native retries. Eight active transfers, ninth rejection, hidden list/remove/clear and source/host closure have live evidence. Destination UI, pause/resume, persistence, physical UI/DPI/accessibility, MOTW/security checks and exhaustive races remain pending.

Page find now uses the actual engine with next/previous, case/wrap options, a native panel and CLI; eight hidden groups cover Unicode transport, owned selection cleanup, queued dismissal, surface pinning, navigation and closure. Native matching equivalence may differ from query codepoints. Popup routing now attaches a never-navigated child in the opener's actual WebView2 environment through SetNewWindow, creating an active tab in the original source pane. Live/pending bounds are 16/8; stale, hidden, closed and invalid-URL requests are rejected. Native close removes the exact browser and replaces a workspace's final browser with a fresh-ID blank view. Fourteen hidden popup groups passed in 45.107 seconds, including opener/Unicode/routing/close/capacity behavior; the ordinary-browser close case records the engine's outcome. Release builds, 141 actual Windows unit tests, 49 related native regression groups and installer packaging passed; results and remaining limits are tracked in the popup record. Full Find API parity, counts/highlight-all/regex, shadow/text-control selection cleanup, exhaustive popup races and cross-origin/named-target policies, physical IME/UI/DPI/accessibility, DevTools and site-permission UI remain pending.

Hidden native WebView2 tests read and edit actual offline Monaco models, verify language IDs and undo/redo, and retain the existing WebView/document/undo history after a pane move. Physical editing, selection, syntax appearance, minimap, fonts, clipboard, IME, DPI and accessibility remain unverified.

CLI Open, duplicate identity, Save, explicit-overwrite Save As and shared UI/CLI serial Save All have hidden native evidence, including ten dirty Unicode documents. Open preparation now runs off the UI thread with pinned source/root and bounded admission. Initial overlapping real-client Open and background picker refusal passed; final-source expired queued Open creates no editor and permits a following Open. Sidebar Open File/editor pick are implemented, but physical dialog selection/cancellation/focus/IME and physical Save All controls remain unverified. WebView2 COM creation remains UI-bound. Source boundaries and failed attempts are preserved in editor-open.md.

Hidden real Monaco/file round trips preserve UTF-8, BOM, LF/CRLF and exact Hangul/NFD/emoji codepoints. Empty and single-line models remain LF internally while disk EOL metadata is retained. Physical text input, clipboard, glyph/width rendering, other encodings and exhaustive file-format cases remain pending.

Explicit disk checks detect clean external changes and dirty conflicts; hidden native commands exercise compare, Keep Mine followed by Save, and explicit Reload against actual models and disk bytes. Automatic watching, physical diff/conflict UI, concurrent-writer races and complete failure coverage remain pending.

Earlier hidden cases cover dirty-close guards, multiple-document restore and acknowledged-edit recovery. Seven final-source editor cases now include deep-path Restore, expired queued Open, accepted close during paused preparation, direct/editor late quit, dirty close and failed-checkpoint unsealing. Controlled lifetime checks suspend only exact owned hidden threads and record balanced resume/clean exit. Two earlier Restore failures are preserved. Unsynchronized edit-debounce/close races, all in-flight checkpoint timings, renderer crashes, power loss and physical confirmation/IME remain unverified.

features.notes: Hidden native evidence covers Unicode paths, root-boundary rejection, explicit overwrite, denied replacement preserving old bytes and isolated recovery storage. Recovery uses a protected-DACL temporary writer. A 266-UTF-16-unit checkpoint temporary-path failure led to extended-length parent paths; final deep-path Restore and the Windows long-checkpoint unit test pass, with the failure retained. Full ACL/ownership preservation, concurrent writers, UNC/network/reparse paths, power-loss durability and exhaustive long-path behavior remain pending.

An in-memory per-window 50-entry log reuses the existing eight-second source dedup and severity escalation. Hidden native tests verify Unicode detail/captions, unread state, current workspace/pane after moves, preserved exited screens and atomic closed-source rejection. Desktop toast delivery/activation, OS taskbar badges, preferences, real foreground suppression/focus and native mouse/keyboard interaction remain pending.

features.notes: Installed console flowmux.com, GUI flowmux.exe and command-only flowmuxctl.exe share parsing/client paths. Leading shell/equals launch flags, CMD/PowerShell resolution and waiting, stdout/stderr, JSON runtime errors, Unicode/empty/quoted argv, two-window targeting, file/NUL redirection and closed stdout verified with hidden native processes. GUI launch explicitly forbids handle inheritance after a reproduced redirected-EOF hang. The JSON launch receipt establishes process creation only. Full legacy command parity, altered PATHEXT/custom shells, clean install/update and interactive desktop coverage remain pending. Native terminal launch now delegates through its originating verified pipe to the GUI host. Both launchers preserve caller UTF-16 argv/cwd/environment, remove stale terminal routing context and reject stale endpoints/surfaces without fallback or replay. Hidden checks verify independent new-window lifetime; broker uses its own GUI build. External job restrictions and timeouts after dispatch remain separate boundaries.

Abandoned-client recovery, atomic discovery and OS-reported pipe PID validation remain verified. IPC now uses 16 reusable overlapped pipes/workers, at most 16 outstanding GUI command permits, whole-frame deadlines, bounded peer-close waits and coordinated cancellation/join before terminal teardown. Native tests cover fragmented Unicode, oversized frames, pending accept/read/write/GUI cancellation, instance reuse, command permit lifetime and repeated pool handle release. Live hidden tests verify 16-of-24 idle admission, idle expiry, CLI reply timeout, unread quit shutdown, multiwindow routing, 640 disconnects and persistence regressions. Commands are not retransmitted after dispatch; a timed-out command may still execute later. The earlier workspace restart failure remains unexplained. Partial startup fault injection, fatal-pool recovery, crash-record cleanup, sustained load/fairness, complete discovery/multi-user/deployment acceptance remain pending.

Stable calling-surface routing survives moves and inactive tabs; identify/tree expose current local cwd, and same-line child CLI context updates cwd before the next prompt. Full context/capability parity, remote environments and cross-window cases remain pending.

Hidden Windows host verifies same-window moves/reorder with stable process, surface, viewport output, cwd and calling-surface CLI routing. Native menu and IME move rerun pending; rename, drag/drop, cross-window and broader feature coverage remain. capture-pane aliases the parser-barrier viewport read; --recent and read-only range metadata are available. Full command parity remains pending. Named keys now use parsed cursor mode and explicit inactive/moved surface targets. New send_key_mode wire requests fail on old hosts instead of letting them ignore a surface selector; new hosts accept legacy send_key. Live byte probes and parser/guard tests are partial evidence; full pane/tab automation parity remains open.

Versioned Windows state and shared terminal/default-shell config use exclusive OS leases/locks and atomic replacement. Config merges fields, rejects stale edits, preserves failed/invalid writes and polls external edits. Outgoing JSON also enforces 64KiB when Unicode argv expands UTF-8 size. Shell/argv persist per surface. Theme import, full configuration parity and remaining data/log/cache features are pending.

Hidden native tests cover independent new-window ownership across source-tab close and clean/forced source-host exit, with original child-process cleanup retained. Sleep/resume, screen lock, external-job containment, desktop multiwindow UX and all-window shutdown remain pending.

gates.notes: Normal exit preserves final output/code after EOF; tab close and forced host termination remove a three-level descendant tree. Invalid-cwd spawn failure and 100 tab cycles verified. Thread creation/pipe failures and broader resize/load cases remain.

Hidden debug host: 1/4/16 panes with 10,000 Korean/color lines each; direct inactive-tab screen read preserves focus. Owned-tree memory after 16-pane output about 2303 MiB. Sustained/peak memory, minimize/lock/resume, release desktop and full screen-consumer parity remain pending.

Hidden debug host: 1/4/16 panes with 10,000 Korean/color lines each; direct inactive-tab screen read preserves focus. Owned-tree memory after 16-pane output about 2303 MiB. Sustained/peak memory, minimize/lock/resume, release desktop and full screen-consumer parity remain pending. Hidden restart additionally verifies bounded styled normal-buffer history, layout identity, window leases and atomic save failure; full persistence/restore coverage remains pending. Bounded viewport/recent reads now have hidden native Unicode/scroll/alternate/exit evidence; agent detection and other screen consumers remain pending. Bounded minimap raster, preview/viewport navigation and alternate gutter stability now have hidden native evidence; full screen-consumer acceptance remains pending.

Same-window pane/workspace moves verified in a hidden host. Controlled real IME, full TUI/scrollback and cross-window ownership remain pending. Hidden restart additionally verifies bounded styled normal-buffer history, layout identity, window leases and atomic save failure; full persistence/restore coverage remains pending.

The initial editor stage has 15 unique native cases and 27 related checks in editor.md. The later Open/picker stage has seven final-source editor cases plus 36 related native checks, with three initial passes and two Restore failures kept separate in editor-open.md. Final Windows debug/release, Clippy, format and 172 actual Windows unit tests pass; entrypoint/package/cleanup results are recorded separately. F01-F05/F17 remain partial. Physical picker/UI/IME/clipboard/fonts/DPI/accessibility, UI-bound WebView construction, automatic watching, search/viewers, full ACL/path semantics and renderer-crash recovery remain open. No feature or complete Windows acceptance gate passes.

Thirty-four Windows browser operations include extra Windows status/stop/zoom commands; the count is not proof of existing-platform command parity. Ref-based DOM actions and viewport PNG capture have hidden evidence, except actual focus/blur. Type/press, complete browser UI parity, physical IME/DPI/accessibility and exhaustive races remain pending. Native download manager/list/cancellation now have partial hidden evidence. Page find and its hidden native panel now have partial engine/Unicode/lifecycle evidence. Native popup-to-tab routing adds no CLI operations and has fourteen passing hidden groups; release builds, 141 actual Windows unit tests, 49 related native regression groups and installer packaging passed; results and limits are tracked in its evidence record.
